actual_injection_policy: Record actual broker SKILL selections separately from synthetic preflight. Abstention in a live cell remains in denominator and is not retried or given extra guidance.
before_evaluation_gate: Both fresh training sessions must satisfy unchanged actual RED/GREEN procedure verifier and official resolve. Actual Gate B promotion and schema2 skill-bank freeze must pass. All evaluation target projections and non-evaluation synthetic controller checks must expose the identical public procedure. On gate failure stop before evaluation; no observation-only fallback or gate relaxation.
concurrency: At most two fresh independent solver cells; evaluations progress one target at a time; training sessions may run concurrently with empty memory. No cross-cell messages.
outcome_policy: One solver attempt and one completed official grade per cell. No outcome-based target substitutions, patch retries, threshold changes, evaluation memory updates or discarded failures.
query_contract: Exact native003/native004 common prompt and initial short issue subgoal plus public regression verification operation retained across all arms; no post-result tuning.
